events.title: Digital Millennium Copyright Act signed into U.S. law
events.summary: President Clinton signed the Digital Millennium Copyright Act on October 28, 1998 — criminalizing circumvention of DRM and creating safe harbors for online service providers.
events.about: The DMCA shaped how developers build media apps, security research, and takedown workflows. Section 1201 anti-circumvention rules affected jailbreaking debates; DMCA takedown notices became routine for GitHub, YouTube, and CDNs. EU equivalents followed in later copyright directives.

narrative.whyChosen: The DMCA set the global template for copyright enforcement on the internet.
narrative.whyImportant: Safe harbors and takedown processes became standard infrastructure for every UGC platform.
narrative.problemSolved: Copyright owners had no clear legal path to remove infringing material online without suing every host.
